headline: Business Intelligence Analyst | Data Analysis and Visualization
summary: Driven Business Intelligence Analyst with 4 years of experience transforming complex data into actionable insights. Proven ability to leverage SQL, Power BI, and Python to uncover trends, optimize business processes, and support data-driven decision making. Passionate about using data to drive impactful results and improve organizational performance.

bullets: Developed and maintained interactive dashboards in Power BI, resulting in a 15% increase in sales team efficiency by providing real-time market insights.
Implemented automated data pipelines using Python and dbt, reducing manual data processing time by 30% and ensuring data accuracy.
Conducted in-depth data analysis to identify customer churn patterns, leading to the implementation of targeted retention strategies that reduced churn rate by 8%.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to define key performance indicators (KPIs) and track progress against business objectives.
Assisted in the design and development of SQL queries to extract data from various sources, contributing to the successful launch of a new marketing campaign.
Prepared data visualizations and reports using Power BI, providing insights that informed strategic decision-making.
Collaborated with senior analysts to develop and maintain data models, ensuring data integrity and consistency.

education.detail: Graduated with honors, specializing in Operations Research and Data Analytics.
